<?php
// Run the seeder dynamically inside the active theme directory
$seeder_file = get_stylesheet_directory() . '/bin/seed-products.php';
if ( file_exists( $seeder_file ) ) {
    require_once $seeder_file;
} else {
    echo 'Warning: Seeder file not found at ' . $seeder_file . '\n';
}
